summary: Focused frontend retest completed on preview URL after memo/sync patch. Mobile collapse behavior, resize sync, anchor-driven panel reveals, keyboard toggles, state persistence, and responsive overflow checks now pass.

integration_issues.flow: Browser console/network during rapid scripted navigation
integration_issues.issue: Console log contains request failures with net::ERR_ABORTED for quick-wing-demo.webm, some images, and repeated /cdn-cgi/rum calls while hopping between routes/viewports.

action_items: Optional: validate whether net::ERR_ABORTED entries are expected from navigation interruption or need asset loading hardening.
No functional accordion/mobile behavior fixes required from this retest.
critical_code_review_comments: LandingPage now uses stable memoized dangerouslySetInnerHTML payload, preventing rerender-driven DOM replacement regression seen in iteration_52.

useMobileSections sync now reads live details collection in syncMode and correctly enforces breakpoint contracts: mobile defaults collapsed, desktop forced open, and mobile open-set restored after resize back.
Exact required summary testids exist once each: landing-summary-{features,field,award,stories,pricing,roi,contact}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at 390 and 320 fresh loads: open count stayed 0/7 immediately and after +2s settle. Desktop 1920: 7/7 open and all seven exact summaries hidden (display:none). 1920->390 became 0/7. Mobile two-open (features+pricing) -> 1440 forced 7/7 -> back 390 restored 2/7. Hash routes /#pricing and /#contact opened correct panels. Hero/demo/pricing/header anchors opened target sections. Form draft and ROI plan toggle persisted across close/reopen and resize. Field gallery next continued after hidden+resize. Feature tab switch updated preview title. No horizontal overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920. Duplicate data-testid check returned [].
rca of the issue: Prior failure (iteration_52) was reproduced as breakpoint state desync likely caused by rerender DOM replacement and stale section snapshots. Current patch addresses both: stable memoized HTML object in LandingPage and live details querying in syncMode. Retest confirms regression resolved on targeted scenarios.
